title: Finite and integral compact-support composition on localizing categories
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y,Z$, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ annihilated by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E\}$, regarded as a condensed ring with the discrete topology for $A$ and its $\ell$-adic topology otherwise [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every standing scheme $T$, use the pulled-back coefficient ring $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and module-object category $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategory $\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and its localizing closure $\mathcal T_T=\Loc(\Dctf(T,\Lambda))$ in this ordinary unbounded derived category [sk-def-localizing-closure].

Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type $k$-morphisms. For $h=f,g,gf$, let $Rh_!$ be the functor $\mathcal T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}\to\mathcal T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence], computed by $Rr_*D(j_!)$ for a compactification $h=rj$, with $j$ quasi-compact open and $r$ proper [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$Rg_!\circ Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(gf)_!: \mathcal T_X\longrightarrow\mathcal T_Z,$$
compatible with the compactification comparison isomorphisms of [det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle], and hence independent of the compactifications under those comparisons.
